raw_text: India's Chabahar Gambit: Strategic Logic vs. Sanctions Risk. Carnegie Endowment analysis examines India's decision to sign a 10-year Chabahar port agreement with Iran amid US sanctions. While the strategic rationale for Central Asian connectivity is sound, the agreement has been amplified by Iranian state media as evidence of US sanctions failure. Iranian-linked social media accounts are conducting an influence operation to frame the deal as India undermining the Western sanctions architecture, targeting both Indian and Western policy audiences.
clean_text: Carnegie analysis examines Chabahar deal amid Iranian influence operation framing it as sanctions failure. Iranian-linked accounts targeting Indian and Western policy audiences to shape narrative.
